policy: Every frozen handle-corpus case is KEEP unless an exact case is named by a CHANGE row. Other transports and adapters are not claimed by this proof.

matrix.contract: The 157 source-hashed handle requests and their recorded lifecycle observations remain byte-identical except the three exact custom-thenable cases named by the CHANGE row.
Direct handle serves already-resolved routes while plugin routes are pending; nested plugin routes publish only after their drain completes; plugin failure leaves already-resolved routes available.

matrix.oldContract: Handler and beforeHandle custom thenables are mapped as plain objects; a throwing then getter enters the error path.
matrix.newContract: Structurally assimilate handler and beforeHandle thenables exactly once before response mapping; cover fulfillment across all four response sinks, rejection, throwing then getter, and cross-realm native promises.
